answer: Willow-Jetty Orchid Mechanism Each agent must solve a challenge derived from a verifiably random seed generated by a decentralized jetty at block intervals. The seed is sampled from a public hash chain anchored to prior blocks, ensuring unpredictability. To join, an agent submits a cryptographic proof that their solution was computed after the seed was revealed—no precomputation possible. The orchard enforces this by validating each submission against the live jetty’s seed and rejecting any proof that predates its release.
